content:
The way people find products online has changed. Not a little. Fundamentally. If you're running an ecommerce store and still think "we'll get to content later," the data says you're already behind. And not by a little. By a lot.

In this issue

  • Google Is Not Dead (Stop Believing the Headlines). Let's address the elephant in the room. Every week brings another article declaring Google's demise.
  • AI Search Is Here (But It's Adding to Google, Not Replacing It). While Google remains dominant, a parallel discovery system has emerged.
  • The Content Gap (Where Winners Separate From Losers). Here's the data point that should change how you think about content:
  • What Is a Content Supply Chain? Your physical products have a supply chain. Raw materials flow in.
  • Building Your Content Supply Chain (Practical Steps). Understanding the concept is one thing. Implementation is another.
  • The Compound Effect. Here's what makes a content supply chain work.
  • The Question. When 53% of your traffic and nearly a quarter of your orders come from search (traditional and AI combined), treating content as an afterthought is treating revenue as an afterthought.
